title: Output/trace panel text not selectable — same 1276 user-select:none regression (and audit other copyable surfaces)
description: DONE (task 1286). Made the Output/trace panel message pane selectable/copyable, mirroring task 1285's exact pattern: (1) OutputPanel.tsx — added userSelect:'text' + WebkitUserSelect:'text' to the messages container (data-testid=output-panel-messages); (2) apps/desktop/src/styles.css — added a scoped allowlist rule [data-testid='output-panel-messages'],[...] * { user-select:text; -webkit-user-select:text; -webkit-touch-callout:default } right after the agent-transcript rule. AUDIT of packages/authoring-ui/src found the only other unfixed copyable surface concern was the AS2 compile-error bar (ActionsPanel.tsx data-testid=as2-error-bar) which already had inline userSelect:'text' but lacked the -webkit- variants — added a matching styles.css allowlist rule for it too. AgentChatPanel transcript already fixed by 1285. Chrome stays protected: the OutputPanel toolbar/Clear button is a SIBLING div outside output-panel-messages, so it keeps the body user-select:none; the rules are scoped to message/error testids only, body{user-select:none} mobile fix (1276) holds everywhere else. VERIFY: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build = all 7 packages green (incl authoring-ui tsc). pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui run test -- --run = Test Files 56 passed (56), Tests 765 passed (765), zero failures (cleaner than the ~3 task-1207 fixture failures that were deemed acceptable).
